# Mauro Toncelli — Photographer & Videomaker

> Freelance photographer and videomaker based in Neuchâtel (Switzerland) and Florence/Peccioli (Tuscany, Italy), available across Europe. Fashion/editorial, e-commerce & product, architecture & interiors, corporate, weddings and events. Also offers B2B technical drone services (roof inspections, construction progress documentation, aerial surveys, damage reports) in Tuscany, with EASA A1/A3 licence.

The site is available in Italian (default), English, German, French and Spanish:
https://maurotoncelli.it/it https://maurotoncelli.it/en https://maurotoncelli.it/de https://maurotoncelli.it/fr https://maurotoncelli.it/es

## Services

- [Fashion / Editorial](https://maurotoncelli.it/it/servizi/moda): editorials, lookbooks and campaigns for fashion brands (worked with Alexander McQueen, Off-White, Akris, Slowear, Intimissimi/Oniverse)
- [E-commerce & Product](https://maurotoncelli.it/it/servizi/e-commerce-prodotto): still life, packshot and on-model photography for online shops and catalogues
- [Architecture, Interiors & Real Estate](https://maurotoncelli.it/it/servizi/architettura-interni): photo and video for architects, interior designers, real estate and hospitality (on quote)
- [Corporate & Brand](https://maurotoncelli.it/it/servizi/corporate-brand): promo videos, professional portraits and brand image
- [Weddings](https://maurotoncelli.it/it/servizi/matrimoni): photo and video, four packages from €800 to €4,500 (Intimate, Essential, Signature, Grand)
- [Events](https://maurotoncelli.it/it/servizi/eventi): corporate events, conferences, product launches
- [Technical drone services in Tuscany](https://maurotoncelli.it/it/servizi/drone): inspections (€200), construction progress documentation (€120/visit or €400/month), aerial surveys (€200), damage reports (€200) — prices exclude any mandatory flight permits, quoted separately — Florence–Peccioli area, delivery within 48h

Prices exclude VAT; quotes are always tailored.
